_comment: Sites check-styled-part-has-setting.py (buttons pass) does not count, each with the reason. A rule whose site is gone fails --check as stale. `has-setting` rules rest on the framework database's block_attributes.css_element (query: SELECT DISTINCT css_element FROM block_attributes WHERE block_slug='sgs/<block>'), read 2026-11-20. Audit-known fixed looks that are NOT button-kit parts (the gallery's lightbox controls, shop filter buttons; carousel arrows and dots are on the kits for sgs/testimonial-slider, sgs/container and sgs/gallery) are deliberately NOT exempt: they stay `unrecognised` so the ceiling holds them until their own pass. The parts_exemptions, parts_width_ok and unmapped_exemptions keys serve the parts and unmapped passes: each rule carries a reason, and a rule or width entry that matches nothing fails --check as stale.

exemptions.reason: sgs/button is the nested content button and the preset system's own consumer; its look is its own settings.
The preset system and the WooCommerce cart and checkout button look (commerce-look/buttons.php): they name the starter presets because they define and apply them.

WooCommerce and core button markup, skinned by the theme from the starter presets: not a part an SGS block renders itself (the cart and checkout look is commerce-look/buttons.php; header CTA is a core button).
A wp-admin screen button, drawn with WordPress's own admin button styles and never printed on the front end.
A pattern that finds or rewrites a <button> already in WooCommerce's markup (adds an icon, swaps the label) or tests for a nested <button>; it prints no button of its own and adds no look.
Trigger and close have look settings (framework DB: sgs/modal css_element trigger, close; close also through sgs_button_element_style_css with prefix close).
The close control has look settings (framework DB: sgs/nav-drawer css_element close, closeIcon).
The write-a-review and see-all buttons have look settings (framework DB: sgs/google-reviews css_element write-review, see-all; painted through sgs_button_element_style_css).
The plan CTA has look settings (framework DB: sgs/pricing-table css_element cta).
Thumbnail, wishlist heart and swatch have look settings (framework DB: sgs/product-card css_element thumbs, wishlist, swatch, swatches).
The back-in-stock Notify me button and the guided meter and navigation buttons have look settings (framework DB: sgs/buybox css_element notifySubmit, guidedMeter, nav).

Cart trigger, panel close, empty-state button, view-cart link and the item stepper, remove and save-for-later controls have look settings (framework DB: sgs/cart css_element trigger, panelClose, panel-empty-cta, panelView, item-stepper, itemRemove, itemAction); the 2026-11-20 audit lists the cart's checkout, view-cart, close, remove and stepper as fine.
Submit, next, previous and step-progress buttons have look settings (framework DB: sgs/form css_element submit-button, next-button, prev-button, nav-button, step-number; submitStyle is an attribute).
The tab buttons have look settings (framework DB: sgs/tabs css_element tab).
The sign-in and register tab switch has look settings (framework DB: sgs/account css_element auth-tab, auth-tabs).
Menu links, sub-menu toggles, mega triggers and the burger have look settings (framework DB: sgs/nav-bar-menu css_element link, burger, burger-bar, item).
A dropdown trigger with look settings (framework DB: sgs/language-switch css_element current; sgs/store-selector css_element trigger).
Filter chips, page buttons and Load more have look settings (framework DB: sgs/accordion css_element chip; sgs/post-grid css_element page-btn, page-button, load-more).
The category filter chips have look settings (framework DB: sgs/post-grid css_element filter).
The announcement arrows have look settings (framework DB: sgs/notice-banner css_element arrows).

The shared slider arrows and dots are printed for sgs/google-reviews and sgs/container, and each has look settings for them (button kit prefix arrow, carousel dots kit prefix dot; framework DB css_element arrow and dot). A new block that adopts the helper must declare the same.
The choice flow info toggle has look settings (framework DB: sgs/choice-flow css_element info-toggle).
The wishlist panel's buttons, links, row actions and share controls have look settings (framework DB: sgs/wishlist-panel css_element button, link, row-actions, share-controls).
The image tile is itself the button that opens the lightbox: it has no look of its own beyond the item settings (framework DB: sgs/gallery css_element item).
A selectable option tile, not an action button; its look is the question's option settings (framework DB: sgs/choice-flow-question css_element option-photo, option-badge, option-description).
A light/dark switch control with its own toggleStyle and icon and label settings (framework DB: sgs/theme-toggle css_element icon, label); it is not a call-to-action button.
The motion pause and play control, whose controls are gated by check-motion-pause-control.py and check-motion-item-parts.py.

The shared carousel runtime builds the dot buttons for a block that prints an empty dots row (buildDots). The class is the calling block's own dot part, and the dots' look is the carousel dots kit (supports.sgs.carouselDots on that block), so the button carries no look of its own.

width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/components/*: Block-editor UI components: printed only inside the editor, never on the front end.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/*/edit.js: Block-editor preview (edit.js): the editor's rendering of the block, not front-end markup.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/*/canvas-*: Block-editor canvas mock of the front-end markup: editor only.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/*/componen: Block-editor panels and canvases inside a block's folder: editor only.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/extensions: Block-editor extensions (motion, inline formats, device toggle): editor only.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/assets/admin/*: wp-admin screen script: never runs on the front end.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/woocommerce/: Checkout summary extras script: it finds WooCommerce's own coupon panel button to open it (sgsCouponOpen) and draws no button of its own; that button's look is the commerce look's coupon_label row.
width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/assets/js/gift-card-*: Selects or enhances the gift card's existing button by class; prints no button of its own.

parts_width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/*/editor.c: Editor-only stylesheets (block.json editorStyle): the block editor canvas, never loaded on the front end.
parts_width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/*/index.cs: Editor-only stylesheets (block.json editorStyle): the block editor canvas, never loaded on the front end.
parts_width_ok.plugins/sgs-blocks/src/components/*: Inspector and editor UI components (the block editor interface a site owner uses): not part of what a visitor sees.
